summary: Iterate Headers using Fetch sorted-and-combined header list semantics.

semantics.order: sorted by header name per Fetch header-list sort and combine
semantics.set_cookie: must preserve standard special handling instead of blindly comma-joining where applicable

caveats: Dictionary enumeration order is not the Fetch Headers iterator contract.
references: WHATWG Fetch Standard sort and combine

tests.name: iteration is name-sorted
tests.input: const h=new Headers(); h.set("z","1"); h.set("a","2"); console.log([...h.keys()].join(","));
